bagPolicy.summary: Only small purses up to 13 inches wide, 4 inches deep and 9 inches high are admitted and searched. Other bags, including backpacks, are prohibited; there is no bag storage.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The operator provides options for paid advance parking near the Riverside Theater; the specific lot and rate depend on the show.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ and Riverside parking page do not designate a rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Bars serve drinks starting when doors open and throughout the show; the theater does not serve food. Outside food, drink and water are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The operator says the theater offers accessible entrances and seating and a ramp or elevator; contact its box office for arrangements.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Riverside Theater operator FAQ does not state a general concert re-entry rule.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will-call tickets are held at the box office and require photo ID; pickup is during box office hours or beginning two hours before showtime. The Riverside box office opens at noon on event days.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Bars open when the event’s doors open. The show-day Riverside box office opens at noon; small purses are searched and other bags cannot be stored.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
